components.semantics: skip link, landmark structure, account and environment identity, responsive primary navigation, route-level heading
components.keyboardContract: The skip link is the first focusable element in the document and moves focus to the main landmark.
components.focusContract: A route change moves focus to the route-level heading.
components.announcementContract: A route change announces the new route title through a polite live region.

components.semantics: organization and publication, lifecycle, entitlement or gate state, exact source and live revision where consequential, permitted actions
components.keyboardContract: Permitted actions are real buttons reachable in standard tab order.
components.focusContract: The region does not steal focus when its data refreshes.
components.announcementContract: Rendered as a labelled region; revision identities are conveyed as text, never by colour alone.

components.keyboardContract: Each hierarchy level is a real, independently focusable link.
components.focusContract: Breadcrumbs never trap or redirect focus.
components.announcementContract: Rendered as a `nav` with an accessible name; the current page is marked `aria-current="page"`; breadcrumbs are never the only indicator of current context.

components.semantics: typed empty, loading, stale, offline, forbidden, not-found, gated, provider-unavailable and final-failure states with exact safe recovery
components.keyboardContract: The recovery action is focusable and reachable by keyboard alone.
components.focusContract: On a terminal-failure transition, focus moves to the alert region.
components.announcementContract: Status text is rendered in a `status` live region for non-urgent states and an `alert` live region for terminal failure.

components.semantics: the controlling entitlement, policy or evidence requirement, preserved data, available alternatives
components.keyboardContract: The disabled action remains present in tab order with its reason programmatically associated.
components.focusContract: Gating never removes the control from the document; it disables it in place.
components.announcementContract: Never renders a misleadingly enabled control; the reason is programmatically associated with the disabled action, not colour or tooltip only.

components.semantics: idle, submitting, accepted, reconciling, succeeded, rejected, final-failed and cancel-boundary presentation sourced from the server operation
components.keyboardContract: The triggering control remains focusable during submission.
components.focusContract: Focus is not moved away from the command during submission.
components.announcementContract: The control uses `aria-disabled` during submit rather than removal; the outcome is announced through a live region; the cancel boundary is stated before it closes.

components.semantics: ordered stages and attempts, current truth, safe evidence references, ambiguity and recovery
components.keyboardContract: Stages are reachable in document order without a keyboard trap.
components.focusContract: The timeline does not steal focus when it polls for an update.
components.announcementContract: Rendered as an ordered list with a per-stage accessible name; attempt status is text; no credential or raw provider payload is rendered.

components.semantics: base, local and remote or source and candidate identity, keyboard navigation, non-colour insert and delete semantics, warnings, exact acceptance target
components.keyboardContract: Per-hunk keyboard navigation follows a documented key map.
components.focusContract: Navigating between hunks moves focus to the active hunk.
components.announcementContract: Insert and delete carry text or `ins`/`del` semantics as well as colour; the acceptance target is named in the confirm control.

components.semantics: effect, consequences, immutable target and version, required typed acknowledgement or recent-auth step, cancel path
components.keyboardContract: Escape cancels; the destructive action is never the default focus.
components.focusContract: Focus is trapped inside the modal dialog and restored to the triggering control on close.
components.announcementContract: Rendered as a modal dialog with `aria-modal`.

components.semantics: one-time disclosure with no DOM, log or telemetry persistence beyond the ceremony, explicit copy acknowledgement, safe expiry
components.keyboardContract: The value is selectable text reachable by keyboard with an accessible name.
components.focusContract: The value is removed from the DOM on acknowledgement or navigation.
components.announcementContract: The copy result is announced through a live region.

components.semantics: caption and heading association, stable column semantics, keyset pagination, responsive alternative, preserved sort and filter URL state
components.keyboardContract: Pagination controls are links or buttons with accessible names reachable by keyboard.
components.focusContract: Refreshing does not move focus off the table.
components.announcementContract: Rendered as a real `table` with `caption` and `th` scope; the responsive alternative preserves reading order.

components.semantics: persistent label, help and error association, input purpose and autocomplete, retained value
components.keyboardContract: Paste and password managers are permitted; there is no keyboard trap on validation.
components.focusContract: The field retains focus while it validates.
components.announcementContract: The label is persistent and programmatically associated; `aria-describedby` links help and error; there is no colour-only validity.

components.semantics: focusable submission result linking to every invalid field while preserving inline errors
components.keyboardContract: Each entry is a link that moves focus to its field.
components.focusContract: Receives focus on a failed submit.
components.announcementContract: Uses `alert` so the summary is announced immediately on a failed submit.

components.semantics: inline or announced outcome with urgency-appropriate live-region behaviour
components.keyboardContract: A dismissible notification exposes a focusable dismiss control.
components.focusContract: A notification never steals focus from the current task.
components.announcementContract: A toast never carries the sole error or recovery information; urgency-appropriate live-region politeness is used.

components.semantics: semantic text plus optional icon or token
components.keyboardContract: Status text carries no interactive semantics of its own.
components.announcementContract: Never renders a raw provider status where Gala owns the user-facing state.
